name: Retiring SEAL
text: Mandatum provided me the opportunity to learn, network, and prepare myself for a successful transition to the civil sector. They work with me specific to my goals and strengths, opening opportunities allowing me to be successful from start to finish in my transition. The Mandatum program and community is a space where I can continue to develop through their programs and network, as well as help other fellows through their transition journey.

name: Chris Eichas, Retired EOD
text: Shortly after committing to transitioning out of the military, I realized that I truly did not know what I wanted to pursue next, or how to narrow down my options. More importantly, I did not know how to clearly articulate and package up the past 20 years of military service and make myself a solid candidate for a potential company. In need of help, I was connected with the Mandatum Foundation and this quickly changed. I received executive coaching and had calls with other transitioning veterans who were in different phases of the transition process. These interactions gave me confidence and taught me the value of patience. The folks at the Mandatum Foundation helped me build my LinkedIn profile and resume. I received one-on-one coaching, which was the most beneficial to me during my transition. This coaching helped me determine what was important to me and my family, how to connect with people, and the values I wanted from a future employer and company. Throughout this process, I learned that it is ok to say no. I had some excellent opportunities presented to me, but I knew they were not exactly what I needed to fit my priorities. I have found a position with a great company that demonstrates the values I share and has built a great team of folks I am excited to work with. I can maximize my military experience and utilize my education with a company that conducts business in a specialized field I truly enjoy. Moving forward I intend to stay engaged with The Mandatum Foundation. I am willing to help other transitioning veterans in any way possible. I am happy to share my experience through this process and hopefully take some of the stress off of others. This can become an extremely stressful process, but at the end of the day, it should be fun.

name: Clint York, Retired Navy SEAL
text: As a transitioning special operations veteran, the biggest challenge isn’t just finding a new career, it’s building the right network to continue making an impact. The Mandatum Foundation has been a critical part of that journey, providing invaluable connections that have directly supported the growth of my coaching business, Bridge Performance Solutions. Their ability to connect veterans with key industry leaders, mentors, and opportunities is second to none. For donors and supporters, your contributions aren’t just helping veterans find jobs, you’re investing in their ability to lead, innovate, and excel beyond service. Mandatum ensures that operators like me don’t just transition, we thrive. Your support fuels a mission that empowers veterans to bring their leadership, resilience, and experience into industries where they can continue making a difference. I’m incredibly grateful for the doors Mandatum has opened, and I encourage those looking to support a truly impactful organization to invest in their mission. It’s not just a donation. It’s a direct contribution to the future success of our nation’s most capable leaders.
